name: pencil-stories
description: Daily motivation YouTube Shorts / Instagram Reels, built with Remotion

scripts.render: npm run render:youtube && npm run render:shorts
scripts.render:youtube: remotion render LaidOff20YearsWide out/layoff/.raw-layoff-youtube.mp4 --crf=14 --x264-preset=slow && python3 scripts/master.py out/layoff/.raw-layoff-youtube.mp4 out/layoff/layoff-youtube.mp4 --remove-input
scripts.render:shorts: remotion render LaidOffShortYouTube out/layoff/.raw-layoff-youtube-shorts.mp4 --crf=14 --x264-preset=slow && python3 scripts/master.py out/layoff/.raw-layoff-youtube-shorts.mp4 out/layoff/layoff-youtube-shorts.mp4 --remove-input && remotion render LaidOffShortReels out/layoff/.raw-layoff-instagram-reels.mp4 --crf=16 --x264-preset=slow && python3 scripts/master.py out/layoff/.raw-layoff-instagram-reels.mp4 out/layoff/layoff-instagram-reels.mp4 --remove-input
scripts.render:brian: remotion render LaidOff20Years out/layoff/.raw-brian-vertical.mp4 --crf=14 --x264-preset=slow && python3 scripts/master.py out/layoff/.raw-brian-vertical.mp4 out/layoff/brian-vertical.mp4 --remove-input
scripts.render:brian-short: remotion render LaidOffShort out/layoff/.raw-brian-short.mp4 --crf=14 --x264-preset=slow && python3 scripts/master.py out/layoff/.raw-brian-short.mp4 out/layoff/brian-short.mp4 --remove-input
scripts.covers: remotion still CoverVertical out/layoff/cover-9x16.png && remotion still ThumbWide out/layoff/thumbnail-16x9.png
scripts.brand: remotion still BrandAvatarFace brand/pencilstories-avatar-face.png && remotion still BrandAvatarIcon brand/pencilstories-avatar-icon.png && remotion still BrandBanner brand/pencilstories-youtube-banner.png && remotion still BrandWordmark brand/pencilstories-wordmark.png --image-format=png && remotion still BrandWatermark brand/pencilstories-youtube-watermark.png --image-format=png
scripts.publish:setup: python3 -m venv tools/publish/.venv && tools/publish/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -q -r tools/publish/requirements.txt
